---
title: Onion Flatbreads
id: MAR-0069
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g bread dough
- 600 g red onions
- 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Work the bread dough, incorporating 2 tablespoons of oil.
2. Peel the onions, slice them, and let them wilt in a pan with 4 tablespoons of oil, 2 tablespoons of water, and a little salt for 30 minutes, moistening them occasionally with a little water.
3. Divide the dough into 4 parts; roll each one out into a thin rectangle, brush with the remaining oil, arrange the onions on top, and bake in the oven at 200° C for 20 minutes.
4. In season, use Tropea red onions.
